game.title: ORBITAL - Journey to Earth
game.description: Steer around a deep-space tube, defeat incoming formations and choose four upgrade colours on the journey from Neptune to Earth. Six safe chance stages reward accurate shooting.
game.controls: Keyboard required: WASD/arrows steer; tap Space fires; X launches/recalls globe; C changes steering; [ / ] turn speed; P/Escape pause; M music; Enter start/retry.
